Initial release of gws-meet.

- Manage Google Meet conferences from the command line.
- Supports operations on conference records, participants, recordings, and transcripts.
- Create, view, update, and end meeting spaces.
- Integrated with the "gws" CLI ecosystem for authentication and configuration.
- Includes built-in command discovery and schema inspection tools for ease of use.
